_note: Sources for scripts/news-finder.mjs besides the Crossref and OpenAlex searches. googleNews: searches of Google News (hl = language, gl = country). googleNewsSites: the same searches kept to the sites of trusted institutions (site: of each host in sites; their own pages on naḥw, ṣarf and their neighbours). journals: journals followed through Crossref by ISSN (every new article, scored). doaj: DOAJ searches (queries) and journals followed there by ISSN (journals): the open-access journals of Iran, the Arab world, Indonesia, Malaysia and Central Asia that Crossref does not hold. feeds: RSS or Atom feeds (a journal's latest issue, a podcast, a YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=<id>, a blog); kind is the news kind (media, event, study, edition, translation, digital), field the science, and always: true lists every new item of a feed that is about naḥw or ṣarf itself, without scoring. Everything is scored for naḥw and ṣarf unless marked always; what a vetted source says on a neighbouring science (balāgha, lugha, manṭiq, uṣūl al-fiqh, tafsīr) gets a section of its own, and what is on naḥw or ṣarf but not from a vetted institution is listed at the end for the owner only, and what an earlier weekly issue listed is not offered again. skipHosts: hosts whose items are never news (lecture series published episode by episode, library catalogues, office documents). trust._note: Strict check: a candidate is kept only when it comes from a Sunni Islamic institution. Journals, DOAJ journals and feeds above are vetted one by one ('by' names the institution). Results of the general searches (Crossref, OpenAlex, DOAJ searches, Google News) count only when their journal's ISSN is one of the vetted journals or listed here, their site is one of these hosts, or their publisher matches one of these patterns and none of the exclusions. onHold: sources kept out until the owner approves them.
